Emergency Help 🚨

If money is lost or your account is hacked, follow these steps immediately.

1) If money is lost (UPI fraud)
  1. Call your bank immediately and report “UPI Fraud”.
  2. Dial 1930 (India Cyber Helpline).
  3. File complaint on cybercrime.gov.in
  4. Save screenshots + transaction ID as evidence.
2) If Instagram is hacked
  1. Reset password immediately.
  2. Enable 2FA (Two-factor authentication).
  3. Logout from all devices.
  4. Check email/phone changes in account settings.
3) If Gmail is hacked
  1. Change password immediately.
  2. Remove unknown devices from Google Security.
  3. Enable 2FA.
  4. Check forwarding rules.
⚠️ CyberRaksha provides guidance only. Money recovery depends on bank/cyber authorities.
